name: Fan (AIMS Math 2025): F1 multiplicative functions in PS sequences, threshold c* = 4/3
comment: Transcription of display (3.18) of Fan, 'A class of small multiplicative functions in Piatetski-Shapiro sequences', AIMS Math. 10(12) (2025) 28514-28523. Variable eta = log_x H, parameter c. QUANTIFIER NOTE: unlike rs_pns.json this is a FEASIBILITY instance (exists eta, for all terms): the fifteen terms of (3.18) are encoded as region constraints a_i*eta <= (1-e0_i) - ec_i*c, the toolkit is empty, and a reported witness is an ADMISSIBLE choice of eta, i.e. the proof succeeds; 'covered' here means infeasible. Conventions: epsilon margins dropped, closed inequalities; the worst dyadic block M = x^c is substituted per the paper's own display (3.14); term x^{1/5+(11/20)c} carries eta-coefficient 0.

expected_coverage.note: Theorem 1.1 threshold: an admissible eta exists iff c <= 4/3 (closed at the facet).
